Details.title: Details
Details.description:
The full connected-car status payload as a JSON string, formatted EXACTLY like this:

{"title":"Your vehicle","vehicle":{"name":"Electric SUV","trim":"RS AWD","imageUrl":"","initials":"EV"},"isElectric":true,"range":{"value":248,"total":312,"unit":"mi"},"battery":78,"odometer":18452,"odometerUnit":"mi","tires":[{"pos":"FL","psi":34,"status":"good"},{"pos":"FR","psi":33,"status":"good"},{"pos":"RL","psi":28,"status":"low"},{"pos":"RR","psi":35,"status":"good"}],"items":[{"label":"Charge","value":"78%","status":"good"},{"label":"Next service","value":"in 1,200 mi","status":"good"},{"label":"Oil life","value":"N/A","status":"good"},{"label":"Tire pressure","value":"1 low","status":"watch"}],"alerts":["Rear-left tire pressure is low (28 psi)"],"updatedText":"Updated 3 min ago","submitText":"Schedule service","submitValue":"I'd like to schedule service for my vehicle"}

Rules:
- 'title' (string, optional): card heading. Defaults to 'Your vehicle'.
- 'vehicle' (object, REQUIRED for real content): { 'name' (string, REQUIRED); 'trim' (string, optional); 'imageUrl' (string, optional — falls back to initials); 'initials' (string, optional — 1-2 letters, derived from name if absent) }.
- 'isElectric' (boolean, optional): true for EV/PHEV; affects charge vs fuel wording.
- 'range' (object, optional): { 'value' (number — remaining range), 'total' (number, optional — full range), 'unit' (string, optional — mi | km) }. Drives the ring gauge (value/total). If 'total' is omitted the ring shows a healthy arc with the range value.
- 'battery' (number, optional): 0-100 percent. Used for the ring when 'range.value' is absent, else shown as a subline.
- 'odometer' (number, optional) + 'odometerUnit' (string, optional — mi | km): shown as a subline when range has no battery.
- 'tires' (array, optional): up to four { 'pos' (string, REQUIRED — one of FL | FR | RL | RR); 'psi' (number); 'status' (string — good | low | high) }. Rendered as a four-corner diagram; low/high tires turn red.
- 'items' (array, optional): up to four { 'label' (string, REQUIRED); 'value' (string); 'status' (string — good | watch | bad) }. Rendered as a service-item grid with a colored status rail.
- 'alerts' (array of strings, optional): active alerts shown in an amber banner.
- 'updatedText' (string, optional): freshness stamp, e.g. 'Updated 3 min ago'.
- 'submitText' (string, optional): CTA label; defaults to 'Schedule service'.
- 'submitValue' (string, optional): message sent back when the CTA is tapped.

At least a 'vehicle.name' or a 'range.value'/'battery' must be present, or the card falls back to sample data. Use these EXACT field names — they are the single contract the card reads.
